verdict.rationale: Versioned APIs with a deprecation policy are a fair question for a workflow platform that exposes a public API, so the axis applies. The pack only contains the bare 'n8n API' docs title, with no mention of API versioning or any deprecation policy. The OpenAPI probe also returned 404 on all candidate paths.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can rely on versioned APIs with a documented deprecation policy
